The Engineer will monitor road conditions and carry out at least fortnightly inspections to verify maintenance standards.
Rectification of filling pot-holes and patch repairs with bituminous concrete must follow the Maximum Response Time standard as per Clause 3004 of MoRTH Specifications.

important_dates.text: The period for submission of the programme for approval of Engineer shall be 30 days from the issue of Letter of Commencement.
The period for setting up a field laboratory with the prescribed equipment relevant to items of work in BOQ is 30 days from the date of notice to start work.

commercial_requirements.text: Amounts for insurance are: a) Rupees equivalent to Contract Price, b) Rupees equivalent to 5% of Contract Price, c) Rupees equivalent to 5% of Contract Price, d) Rupees 20 lakhs for multiple incidents.
Amount to be withheld for delays in submission of updated programme: 1% of value of work corresponding to the updated programme.

Amount of liquidated damages for delay in completion of works is 0.1 percent of the remaining value of contract to be executed, rounded off to the nearest thousand, per day with the minimum of Rs. 10000/- per day.
Maximum limit of liquidated damages for delay in completion of work is 10 percent of the Initial Contract Price rounded off to the nearest thousand.

important_conditions.text: The standard form of Performance Security acceptable to the Employer shall be an unconditional e-Bank Guarantee.
The Performance Security shall also be forfeited if the Contract is terminated because of a fundamental breach of Contract by the Contractor.
The percentage to apply to the value of work not completed representing the Employer's additional cost for completing the work shall be 20 percent.

The reasonable cost of removal of equipment and repatriation of the Contractor's personnel employed solely on the works in the event of termination of the contract at the Employer's convenience or because of a fundamental breach of contract by the Employer is to be treated as NIL.

Carbon foot prints shall be evaluated during the execution of project. If approved by the Employer, environment friendly machinery like Infrared Recycling Road Maintenance as approved by CRRI/IRC/MoRTH shall be got deployed.

overview.text: The RFP is for 'Balance work for rectification of damages caused to bituminous pavement and road side drain for laying of PHED pipelines' under the project of 'Construction of 2-lane specification road with paved shoulder including Tunnel (300 m) at Rabongla on NH-510', Package-III.
The work is located from Design Chainage KM 32.500 to Km 33.600 in the State of Sikkim, under jurisdiction of PMU-Gyalshing and NHIDCL.
The tender basis is Percentage Rate Contract Basis under the EPC framework.
This is the 2nd Call for bidding.

important_dates.text: Bid remains binding and may be accepted for a period of 120 days from the last date fixed for Bid Submission.
Contractor shall commence work within fifteen (15) days of receipt of the order to commence if Bid is accepted.

commercial_requirements.text: The Bid shall be submitted on a Percentage Rate Contract Basis.

Rates and prices tendered in the Bill of Quantities shall include all equipment, tools, spares, labour, supervision, overheads, consumables, materials, erection, maintenance, testing, profit, taxes (excl GST), duties, general risks, liabilities, obligations, and incidentals.
The basis of payment will be actual quantities of items of work carried out and valued at the rates tendered in the BOQ along with accepted/awarded tender premium.

Payment for performance based activities shall be indexed on a performance scale of 100 marks, applicable between 80% to 100% average performance; payment is not entitled if average performance is rated less than 80%.

overview.text: The document is a Bill of Quantities (BOQ) for Road Maintenance Works, which must be read in conjunction with Instructions to Bidders, Conditions of Contract, Road Maintenance Standards, and Specifications.
Payment basis relies on actual quantities of work carried out valued at tendered rates along with any accepted/awarded tender premium.
The BOQ includes estimated quantities for various road construction and maintenance items, including subgrade compaction, base courses, and bituminous concrete layers.

commercial_requirements.text: The quantities given in the Bill of Quantities are estimated quantities. The basis of payment will be actual quantities of items of work carried out and valued at the rates tendered in the BOQ along with accepted/awarded tender premium.

The rates and prices tendered in the BOQ shall include all equipment, tools, spares, labour, supervision, overheads, consumables, materials, erection, maintenance, testing of input material delivered, profit, taxes (excl GST) and duties together with general risks, liabilities and obligations set out and implied in the contract.

Payment for performance based activities like maintenance of median and existing plants (Item no. 2.1), treatment and repair of pot holes/ruts (Item no. 3.1) and providing route patrol and surveillance, automobile assistance, tow away cranes and ambulance services (Item no. 3.2) shall be indexed on performance scale of 100 marks as given in Table below.

Performance assessment for performance based items of work, shall be done through inspection by the Engineer at least two times during the month and overall rating can be done on the basis of average of assessments made during the inspection.
The Contractor shall submit at least once in two months video recording of condition of the Project Highway with special emphasis on performance based items.
For performance based items of work, the Contractor shall be entitled for receiving payment proportionate to the average percentage performance assessed for achievement between 80% to 100%.
The Contractor shall not be entitled for payment of performance based items of work if the average performance is rated less than 80%.
A rate or price shall be entered as a single rate as Tender Premium % above/below on the rate/amount in the BOQ.

Payment is calculated based on 'Without Taxes' rates provided in the Bill of Quantities for specific items such as Compacting original ground (Item 1), GSB-Plant Mix (Item 2), Wet Mix Macadam (Item 3), etc.
